name: Purchase Order from Sale Order
description:
Purchase Order from Sale Order automates the purchasing process by allowing users to generate Purchase Orders directly from confirmed Sale Orders in Odoo. This app bridges the gap between Sales and Purchase, ensuring faster procurement, reduced manual work, and accurate order fulfillment.

When a Sale Order is confirmed, users can instantly create related Purchase Orders for vendors based on customer demand. This is ideal for make-to-order, dropshipping, and on-demand procurement workflows.

The module improves coordination between sales and purchasing teams, reduces delays, and ensures that customer requirements are fulfilled efficiently.

name: Bill of Material (BOM) Cost Price
description:
Bill of Material Cost Price
The Bill of Material Cost Price module allows accurate calculation of estimated costs for bills of material and manufactured final products. It provides clear cost visibility across manufacturing records, improving cost analysis and decision making.

Key Features
1. Estimated Cost Calculation
Automatically calculates the estimated cost of bills of material and manufactured final products based on defined components.

2. Total BOM Cost in Tree List View
Displays the Total BOM Cost directly in the bills of material tree or list view under Manufacturing → Master Data → Bills of Materials.

3. Detailed Cost View in BOM Form
Shows individual cost, total cost, and total BOM cost within the bill of material form view for better cost breakdown and clarity.

4. Final BOM Cost in Product Form
Displays the final BOM cost in the product form view under Manufacturing → Master Data → Products for easy reference.
